postCreateCommand:
curl -sSL https://dl.google.com/linux/direct/google-chrome-stable_current_amd64.deb -o /tmp/chrome.deb && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y /tmp/chrome.deb && rm /tmp/chrome.deb && mkdir -p ~/Desktop && printf '[Desktop Entry]
Version=1.0
Name=Kaggle Chrome
Exec=google-chrome --no-sandbox https://www.kaggle.com
Icon=google-chrome
Terminal=false
Type=Application
' > ~/Desktop/kaggle.desktop && chmod +x ~/Desktop/kaggle.desktop
